# Premium Developer Portfolio - Anfas CK

A futuristic, high-end developer portfolio designed with a focus on premium aesthetics and performance.

## Features
- **Matrix Background**: Real-time code rain animation on canvas.
- **Glassmorphism**: Elegant, transluscent UI panels with backdrop-blur.
- **Custom Cursor**: Interactive point-and-follower system for desktop.
- **Typing Effect**: Dynamic display of multiple developer personas.
- **AOS Animations**: Smooth scroll-triggered visual entries.
- **Stats Counter**: Live counting of experience and project metrics.
- **Photo Modal**: Full-screen interactive profile view.
- **No Backend**: Contact form redirects to a direct email transmission (mailto).

## Project Structure
- `index.html`: Main architecture and SEO-optimized structure.
- `style.css`: The "Architectural Design System" with all tokens.
- `script.js`: Interactivity, animations, and form logic.
- `profile.png`: Your primary headshot (should be placed in the root).

## How to Run
1. Open this folder in any local server (e.g., VS Code Live Server, Vite, or simply open `index.html` in a browser).
2. The portfolio will run perfectly as it is completely static.

## Note on Profile Image
Ensure you have a file named `profile.png` in this directory for the profile and modal to display correctly.
